'''Daek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] orphan who lived on [[Mannett Point]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. During the [[Separatist War]], he was one of many orphans who were under the care of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Jaen Kett]], and the group was evacuated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />
